journey: S21 first student launch (local rehearsal, throwaway Postgres 16; no hosted environment)

steps.title: admin issues an invitation; only the SHA-256 hash is stored; staff/students cannot issue
signup is invitation-gated and, with ENABLE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true, creates an UNCONFIRMED account with no session
steps.mocked: Supabase Auth createUser/signIn (provider behaviour emulated); invitation rows are real

steps.title: email verification: only a provider-confirmed email counts; unconfirmed/invalid links never report success
steps.mocked: Supabase verifyOtp/getUser answers are scripted; the route, validation and response contract are real

steps.title: session handling: valid token works; expired, tampered, forged-issuer and absent tokens are 401; suspended account is refused
steps.mocked: account-status lookup is doubled; JWT verification and RBAC are real (local-JWT dev path, not Supabase JWTs)

steps.title: staff creates the student record; admin links the login (account linkage)
high-school enrollment + plan: 17 core courses = 16 core credits, 6 electives = 5 credits (incl. two 0.5-credit), total 21 credits = 42 half-units; admin publishes
academic projection before any evidence: nothing official, nothing invented (no graduation date, no earned credit)
student reports progress: submitted -> awaiting_school, started -> in_progress, untouched -> planned; none of it is official credit
document upload -> staff rejection with a student-visible reason (internal note hidden) -> student resubmission -> staff verification
steps.mocked: object storage (the signed upload itself is not exercised); audit sink

steps.title: official results from verified evidence: english-1 (2 half-units) + a 0.5-credit elective (1 half-unit) = 3 half-units; buckets stay distinct
access isolation: student B cannot read or change student A's projection, documents, billing, tickets or staff surfaces
support: ticket creation, staff reply, student reply with Idempotency-Key sent twice => exactly one comment; internal notes hidden
steps.mocked: support tables are the S08 in-memory fake (not in the local migration chain); the 20261031100000 unique index is covered by scripts/s20/verify-migrations.ts

steps.title: staff configure billing (obligation, discount, 4 installments); student sees exact integer-cent totals and no staff-only fields
proof of payment: student-uploaded evidence never counts until staff confirm; confirming records an exact receipt
steps.mocked: object storage for the proof file; audit sink

steps.title: correction: void the receipt (reason required) -> totals revert, evidence returns to review; same evidence backs ONE new receipt, never two
first-login welcome is server-derived: 'first' once, then 'returning'; attention counts only real items (resubmitted rejection is not counted)
student opens Lumière Guide and starts a conversation; the student message and local reply are stored in Postgres with a hash chain
steps.mocked: live model disabled (students are never live-eligible); budget store unused

steps.title: student attaches an existing Document (their verified transcript) to a message; another student's document is refused
steps.mocked: object storage (attaching reuses the stored document row; the new-upload finalize path is covered by tests/s21-attachments-service-db.test.ts)

steps.title: logout + return (new session/device): the conversation list, history, attachment reference and integrity are intact
steps.mocked: a second local JWT stands in for the new session

steps.title: memory: the stated goal is remembered as student-reported with a source link; later 'which universities did we discuss for communications?' cites the earlier discussion; no official record changes
global search: student finds own course, document, conversation and Billing; staff search returns students only
another student cannot list, read, post to, search or attach into student A's conversations, memory or documents
tamper evidence: a direct SQL edit of a stored message (trigger bypassed as superuser) is detected by the integrity check
